policy: Byte-identical copies of the final DEO2LEG artifacts, published so consumers need only read outputs/. Never edit these files: regenerate with build_mapping.py then republish. MANIFEST sha256 values are the integrity check; 'publish_outputs.py --check' verifies copies against both the canonical build and this manifest.

pathResolution.base: DEO2LEG/ (the repository directory containing this outputs/ folder)
pathResolution.note: Files are copied byte-for-byte, so every relative path inside them is still resolved from the DEO2LEG root, NOT from outputs/. The only such field is representative.profile.photoPath, e.g. 'legislative_profiles/photos/foo.jpg' -> DEO2LEG/legislative_profiles/photos/foo.jpg. Portraits are NOT copied into outputs/ (44MB of scraped assets; they are inputs, not outputs). Do not rewrite the JSON to make paths outputs-relative: that would break byte-identity and invalidate these hashes.

files.description: Mapping graph: DEO offices <-> legislative districts <-> representatives. Structure only; contains no monetary amounts.
Evidence sidecar: all 264 allocation rows with transcribed amounts and page/row provenance. Kept separate so the reusable graph stays free of transient fiscal values.

notPublished.reason: Scraped portrait assets (44MB); inputs, not outputs. Referenced by photoPath.
Superseded schema 0.1.0 draft (108-row partial crosswalk). Retained as a historical artifact, deliberately not published.
